issue.title: Resolve unused notification tab-icon Symvision finding
issue.description: During verification for unrelated bead sase-iw, `just check` passed fmt, keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, pyscripts, test-waits, changelog, and patch/stitch terminology, then failed at lint (symvision): `resolve_notification_tab_icon in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/notification_tab_style.py` is reported as an unused public function/class. The implementation diff for sase-iw does not touch src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/notification_tab_style.py (confirmed by an empty git diff for that file), so this is pre-existing and blocks every agent that reaches the normal check gate before scoped tests. Scope: either make the symbol private/delete it if it is genuinely file-local/dead, or add the correct visible consumer/pragma if Symvision cannot see a real public use; then verify with `just _lint-symvision` and `just check`.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction during tale-size PLAN-lane verification on 2026-08-10: just check-full passed fmt, keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, pyscripts, test-waits, changelog, and patch/stitch terminology, then failed lint (symvision) on unused public symbol resolve_notification_tab_icon in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/notification_tab_style.py. This change did not touch that file, and the failure blocks check-full before the full test lane.
